name: The Minish Cap Pack — Link & Princess Zelda + Hyrule & Dark World
author: HyruleChosenOne
description: Playable Young Link (OOT cries) & Princess Zelda (both unlocked by default), 6 Wardrobe skins each, shared exclusive Minish Cap attacks + Light Arrows Fusion, and 3D Hyrule Castle & Pyramid of Power stages.

customMoves.name: Picori Blade
customMoves.flavor: Link strikes swiftly with the sacred Picori Blade in twin emerald-gold sword arcs. Fuses with Hero's Bow into Light Arrows.

customMoves.name: Hero's Bow
customMoves.flavor: Fires swift silver-tipped arrows from Link's Minish Cap Bow. Fuses with Picori Blade into Light Arrows!

customMoves.name: Gust Jar
customMoves.flavor: Unleashes a roaring compressed gale from the Gust Jar that blasts crowds backward.

customMoves.name: Magical Boomerang
customMoves.flavor: Throws the Magical Boomerang in a curved returning arc that slices and stuns foes twice.

customMoves.name: Flame Lantern
customMoves.flavor: Swings the Flame Lantern to unleash a searing ring of embers that ignites surrounding foes.

customMoves.name: Cane of Pacci
customMoves.flavor: Fires an overturning beam of Picori magic from the Cane of Pacci that flips enemies.

customMoves.name: Mole Mitts
customMoves.flavor: Tears through earth with Minish Mole Mitts, hurling seismic rock slashes at nearby hordes.

customMoves.name: Remote Bombs
customMoves.flavor: Tosses Minish Cap Remote Bombs that detonate in high-impact azure-gold blast waves.

customMoves.name: Roc's Cape
customMoves.flavor: Soars on golden Roc's Cape air currents and sends razor wind waves crashing outward.

customItems.name: Gold Kinstone
customItems.desc: +14% Crit Chance & +15% Luck from fused Picori fortune.

customItems.name: Pegasus Boots
customItems.desc: +14% Move Speed & +12% Attack Speed — dash like the wind!

customItems.name: Mirror Shield
customItems.desc: +18 Armor & +14% Max HP — sacred Hylian bulwark.

customItems.name: Ocarina of Wind
customItems.desc: +16% Area & +10% Move Speed — summons Zeffa's tailwind.

characters.name: Link (Minish Cap)

customUlt.name: Four Sword Hurricane Spin
customUlt.desc: Link splits into the Four Sword formation and unleashes a massive emerald-gold hurricane spin shockwave.

characters.flavor: Chosen Hero of Hyrule accompanied by Ezlo the Minish Cap. Wields the Picori Blade, Hero's Bow, Gust Jar, Magical Boomerang, Flame Lantern, Cane of Pacci, Mole Mitts, Remote Bombs, and Roc's Cape — fusing Sword & Bow into Light Arrows!

characters.name: Princess Zelda (Minish Cap)

customUlt.name: Triforce of Wisdom — Sacred Light Seal
customUlt.desc: Princess Zelda raises the Light Force and invokes the Triforce of Wisdom, unleashing a radiant golden-magenta light seal that obliterates surrounding foes.

characters.flavor: Princess of Hyrule bearing the sacred Light Force. Shares the full Minish Cap Sword & Items arsenal with Young Link, fusing Picori Blade & Hero's Bow into Light Arrows!

customLevels.name: Hyrule Field — Hyrule Castle
customLevels.desc: Sunlit emerald plains of Hyrule with a cobblestone royal highway crossing the Castle Moat to the 3D Hyrule Castle.

customLevels.name: The Dark World — Pyramid of Power
customLevels.desc: Corrupted golden-ochre twilight realm cut by violet canals rising toward the monumental 3D Pyramid of Power.
